plain.li: {YEARS} years. I can feel the end of them coming, not soon, but coming.
I sleep more than I used to, and the stairs are longer every day. I know what that means.
My body's tired in a way rest doesn't fix. I've had a long life, and I'd like the rest of it to be good.
I'm not afraid of it. I'd only like the people I love near when it comes.
Every morning I wake up I count it as a gift now. {YEARS} years, and still a few more mornings.
I've started giving things away. Small things. It feels right to.

warm.li: I want to spend what's left with all of them, every evening, for as long as I've got.

gloomy.li: So this is how it ends: slowly, then all at once. I'd hoped for more time.

cold.li: I am failing. It was always going to happen. I have arrangements to make.

cheerful.li: {YEARS} years, and I'm not finished yet. Not quite.
